attributes.title: CASP Convention 2027
attributes.series: CASP Annual Convention (California Association of School Psychologists)
attributes.summary:
The California Association of School Psychologists has set its 2027 convention for October 12 to 15, 2027, in Costa Mesa, California. The association announced the dates and city right after its 2026 convention; the venue, program, registration and fees for 2027 had not been posted when we checked in November 2026.

CASP's convention is the main statewide gathering for school psychologists and licensed educational psychologists (LEPs) in California, along with other school-based mental health staff. The association reports that its convention drew more than 1,100 attendees from across the state, with workshops, paper presentations and an exhibit hall.

The CASP pages we checked do not state how many continuing education credits the 2027 convention will offer or which bodies approve them. School psychologists who need CE for a state license, an LEP license or NCSP renewal should confirm credit details with CASP once registration opens.
